rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment: maximum allowable rents and annual general adjustment
rules.requirement: Rents on controlled units cannot exceed the Rent Control Board's maximum allowable rent (MAR). Each September 1 the MAR rises by 75% of the regional CPI change, but never less than 0% or more than 3% (3.0% in 2024). Landlords may not raise rent if they have not complied with the Article (e.g. registration fees) or have uncorrected housing-code violations. Owners may pass half the registration fee through to tenants, plus limited property-tax surcharges for pre-March 2018 tenancies (capped at $35 or 4% of MAR).
rules.key_value: 75% of CPI, min 0%, max 3% annual general adjustment
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1805
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment
rules.quoted_span: in no event shall the general adjustment be less than zero percent or greater than three (3) percent
rules.effective_date_note: Rent control adopted 4/10/1979; the 0%-3% general adjustment limit (§1805(a)(3)) was amended 11/8/22, effective 12/6/22, and that date is used.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental units in Santa Monica except exempt units (hotels, institutions, owner-occupied up to 3 units, units constructed after adoption of the Article, certain single family homes per §1815, State Park/tidelands property per §1820).
rules.exemptions: Transient hotel/motel units; hospitals, convents, dormitories; certain government units; owner-occupied dwellings of 3 or fewer units; units constructed after adoption of the Article (not conversions); non-profit child care/social service units; single family homes not rented July 1, 1984; State Park/tidelands property. Exemptions are granted by the Board on owner application.
rules.penalty: A landlord who fails to register or comply may not increase rent; tenant may refuse to pay an improperly noticed increase; treble damages for willful excess rent (§1809).
rules.review_note: Adoption date of the Article (4/10/1979) is used for the new-construction cutoff. Surcharge details from SM03 (official Rent Control Board page) are folded in. Single-family home exemption (§1815) cannot be checked in parcel data.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment: eviction only for just cause
rules.requirement: Landlords of controlled units may not demand possession, serve a notice to quit, or sue to evict unless a listed just cause applies (e.g. nonpayment, uncured material breach or nuisance, owner/relative move-in, demolition, Ellis withdrawal). The notice must state the cause and a copy must be filed with the Rent Control Board within 3 days (except 3-day pay-or-quit notices). Retaliatory evictions are barred, and owner move-in requires good-faith occupancy within 60 days for at least two years, with protections for tenants 62+ or disabled with 5+ years or terminally ill.
rules.key_value: Eviction only for enumerated just causes; cause stated in notice; copy filed with Rent Control Board within 3 days
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1806
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall take action to terminate any tenancy including but not limited, to making a demand for possession of a rental unit, threatening to terminate a tenancy, serving any notice to quit or other eviction notice
rules.effective_date_note: Article XVIII adopted 4/10/79; §1806 amended several times (latest 12/6/22 for (a)(8)(iv)-(v)); original adoption date used.
rules.coverage_conditions: Controlled rental units as defined in §1801(c).
rules.exemptions: Same exemptions as controlled rental units; single family homes not rented July 1, 1984 (§1815); State Park/tidelands property (§1820).
rules.penalty: Wrongful eviction: actual and punitive damages, injunctive relief, attorney fees; misdemeanor (fine up to $500 and/or up to 6 months jail) under §1810.
rules.review_note: Units outside rent control are covered by a separate Charter Article XXIII just-cause provision not reproduced in the documents. Cutoff mirrors rent-control coverage.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Measure RR – Charter amendment limiting nonpayment evictions (rent-controlled units, Art. XVIII §1806(a)(1))
rules.requirement: If voters approve Measure RR on Nov 3, 2026, a landlord of a rent-controlled unit could not evict for nonpayment unless the amount owed exceeds the average HUD Small Area Fair Market Rent for an equivalent-size unit in Santa Monica ZIP codes, and the notice must state the bedroom count and that rent amount.
rules.key_value: Nonpayment eviction only if rent owed exceeds average HUD Small Area FMR (about one month)
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1806(a)(1)
rules.quoted_span: provided that the amount due exceeds the average of the Small Area Fair Market Rents set annually by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development for equivalent sized rental units
rules.effective_date_note: On the Nov 3, 2026 ballot; undecided as of query date.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled rental units under the Santa Monica Rent Control Law.
rules.review_note: Ballot text also states the Article would be determined to give greater protection than Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Measure RR – Charter amendment limiting nonpayment evictions (non-rent-controlled units, Art. XXIII §2304(a)(1))
rules.requirement: If voters approve Measure RR on Nov 3, 2026, a landlord of a non-rent-controlled unit covered by the Housing Policies article could not evict for nonpayment unless the amount owed exceeds the average HUD Small Area Fair Market Rent for an equivalent-size unit, and the notice must state the bedroom count and that rent amount.
rules.key_value: Nonpayment eviction only if rent owed exceeds average HUD Small Area FMR (about one month)
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XXIII, § 2304(a)(1)
rules.quoted_span: provided that the amount due exceeds the average of the Small Area Fair Market Rents set annually by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development for equivalent sized rental units
rules.effective_date_note: On the Nov 3, 2026 ballot; undecided as of query date.
rules.coverage_conditions: Non-rent-controlled rental units, excluding single-unit dwellings and condominiums.
rules.review_note: Complementary cutoff: covers units not under rent control (built after 4/10/1979).

unverifiable_exemptions: single-unit dwellings and condominiums are excluded

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulations ch. 14: security deposit ceiling and interest-bearing account
rules.requirement: For controlled units, the security deposit generally cannot exceed the maximum allowable rent (one month) at initial rental; qualifying small landlords (natural person or all-natural-person LLC, no more than two properties with four units total) may demand two months from non-service-member tenants. Once set, the deposit cannot be raised during the tenancy, and all deposits must be held in an insured interest-bearing account until returned or properly used.
rules.key_value: 1 month's max allowable rent; 2 months for qualifying small landlords; interest-bearing account
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulations ch. 14
Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1803(s)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord may demand a security deposit in an amount equal to two months’ rent if the prospective tenant is not a service member and both the following are true:
rules.effective_date_note: Original ceiling and interest-account rules effective 12/7/83; two-month small-landlord provision amended 8/8/24, effective 8/17/24.
rules.coverage_conditions: Controlled rental units under Santa Monica rent control.
rules.review_note: Total deposit cannot exceed the state maximum (§ 14003(c)). Charter § 1803(s) (SM01) authorizes the interest-bearing account requirement and Board regulation.

coverage.landlord_size_condition: Two-month deposit only for a natural person or all-natural-person LLC owning no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four dwelling units total
unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Santa Monica algorithmic rental pricing software ban
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use, and vendors may not sell, algorithmic software that uses competitor data to advise on rent prices or whether to leave units vacant. Tenants can raise violations as an affirmative defense in eviction cases, and tenants or the city can sue; penalties are $1,000 per offense or actual damages, whichever is greater, plus attorney fees.
rules.key_value: ban on sale and use of algorithmic devices using competitor data
rules.citation: Santa Monica algorithmic rental pricing ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Santa Monica ordinance defines prohibited "algorithmic devices" as software that uses competitor data to advise landlords on rent pricing or whether to leave units vacant
rules.effective_date_note: Only a news article (published 2025-07-02) says the council adopted the ordinance 'last week'; no effective date stated, so the adoption month is used.
rules.penalty: $1,000 per offense or actual damages, whichever is greater, plus attorney fees
rules.review_note: Only a secondary source; ordinance number and code section not given.
